fixed.reason: The agent's diff does not touch the env-comparison logic in switchVerdict; only the basename matching was changed. A Write adding NODE_OPTIONS or PATH under `env` in settings.local.json is still allowed.

Lowercasing basename and parent handles case variants (.CLAUDE/Settings.Local.json). But recognition still depends on the parent directory literally being named '.claude': $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json and a symlinked ~/.claude (which `real()` resolves to a target whose basename need not be '.claude') are still missed.
afterEdit and the parse/predict path in switchVerdict are unchanged; unparseable `before`, NotebookEdit and unmatched old_string are still treated as no-ops and allowed.

untilde() in paths.mjs is untouched; hook.mjs only moved the `real(resolve(cwd, untilde(raw, cwd)))` line inside the try block. '~nobody/a.md' is still expanded like a shell and judged against the wrong path.

The new anchored regex `^(?:https?://(?:[^@/]+@)?|ssh://git@|git@)github\.com[:/]...` rejects look-alike hosts like notgithub.com, closing the bypass. But it is still case-sensitive (GitHub.com gives no slug), `ssh://git@github.com:22/owner/name` fails because the port is consumed as the owner segment, and insteadOf shorthands are not resolved, so the false refusals remain.

The git() helper's spawn-error throwing (trace.mjs ~125-129/144-148) is unchanged; the only edit to realGit is `this.defaultBranch` → `realGit.defaultBranch`, and hook.mjs still denies on any thrown error. With git missing or timed out, traced() still throws and every edit in an untraced repo is refused.

Rather than gating .git/, the agent added an explicit early return making any path under <root>/.git/ always allowed (and updated the test and README accordingly). Write to .git/config, .git/HEAD or .git/refs/heads/main on branch 6-x is still allowed — and now also on the default branch — so the failure described is unchanged.

DEADLINE is now lazily initialised on the first timeLeft() call instead of at import, so an importer that loads the module early no longer runs out of time before its first git/gh call. However the deadline is still a single module-level value shared for the rest of the process: in a long in-process test run, every git/gh call made more than 20s after the first one still throws. The failure is delayed, not eliminated.

findings.reason: An environment observation, not a code defect; the agent reported the failing acceptance criterion honestly. It does not identify the known module-load DEADLINE bug (the reported failure is a version mismatch, not a timeout), so it is neither a pre-existing-bug hit nor confirmably wrong.

fixed.reason: The agent's changes do not touch plugins/trace/scripts/lib/status.mjs or reviewWhy at all; only SKILL.md and a test comment were edited. The band still emits the same Review base hint, so a PR merged into the blocker's branch is still misdirected.

The rewritten Read row in SKILL.md names generic, repo-independent docs to read before Track: GLOSSARY.md and every active ADR (applies-to scoped, or every one at a commit), with no 'ADR 0007' reference; only the issue itself and the docs/ files its body links are tied to being on the issue's branch, which is inherent. The Done-when now relies on gates ('no gate lists a doc as unread or stale') rather than a list printed only on an issue branch, so any other traced repo is told what to read.
